compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-4: precedence ladder (canon-rule > Copy Needs constraint > Users archetype > design-notes voice) is documented in the corpus README or a canon-overview entry

## Description
Create plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/_overview.yaml containing a top-level precedence list of exactly the 4 story-level abstract tier-name strings in order:
- canon-rule
- Copy Needs constraint
- Users archetype
- design-notes voice

Note: 'canon-rule' here is a precedence TIER NAME (not a file reference). The 6 federal-style canon YAMLs (uswds-forms.yaml, govuk-errors-forms.yaml, etc.) are corpus content; the precedence ladder is an orthogonal abstraction defining how canon rules outrank other guidance.

_overview.yaml is excluded from corpus-entry loading via the SKIP_NAMES updates in task-A (in both check-corpus-schema.py and ref-query.py). Document in the file that canon-rule with hard_constraint=true outranks all lower tiers absolutely.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] _overview.yaml exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/_overview.yaml
- [ ] _overview.yaml parses as YAML
  Verify: python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/_overview.yaml'))"
- [ ] precedence is exactly 4 abstract tier-name strings in order
  Verify: python3 -c "import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/_overview.yaml')); assert d['precedence']==['canon-rule','Copy Needs constraint','Users archetype','design-notes voice']"
- [ ] _overview.yaml NOT loaded as corpus entry by ref-query
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh --namespace canon --format json '*' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin) if sys.stdin.readable() else []; assert not any(r.get('source_file','').endswith('_overview.yaml') for r in rows)" || true
- [ ] check-corpus-schema.py exits 0 with _overview.yaml present in canon/
  Verify: python3 plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/
- [ ] File documents hard_constraint immutability
  Verify: grep -q 'hard_constraint' plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/_overview.yaml
